macbook12-spi-driver-dkms on Omarchy

Kernel driver that brings the keyboard, trackpad, Touch Bar, and light sensor of newer MacBooks to Linux.

Package data synced 2026-10-20 · generated from the official Omarchy package repo

Short answer

To install macbook12-spi-driver-dkms on Omarchy, open a terminal and run omarchy pkg add macbook12-spi-driver-dkms. It is a 54.8 KB download (181.5 KB installed), version 0+git.315-2, licensed GPL2. Driver for the keyboard, touchpad and touchbar found in newer MacBook (Pro) models. Free and open source.

Install macbook12-spi-driver-dkms on Omarchy

This DKMS package builds and installs the input driver for the SPI-connected keyboard and touchpad found in the 12-inch MacBook (2015+) and the 2016-2018 MacBook Pro (13-inch and 15-inch Touch Bar models). Basic keyboard and trackpad support has since been merged into the mainline Linux kernel, so today this package is mainly useful for its extras: Touch Bar support (with idle dimming), the ambient light sensor, and low-level packet tracing for debugging.

  1. Open a terminal.
  2. Run the install command:
    omarchy pkg add macbook12-spi-driver-dkms
  3. Check it landed. Pacman should list version 0+git.315-2:
    pacman -Qi macbook12-spi-driver-dkms

Open and use macbook12-spi-driver-dkms

macbook12-spi-driver-dkms has no window of its own: it is a command-line tool, library or system component. To see the commands it added to your PATH:

pacman -Ql macbook12-spi-driver-dkms | grep /usr/bin/

macbook12-spi-driver-dkms requirements and compatibility

  • A 12-inch MacBook (2015 or later) or a 2016-2018 MacBook Pro (13"/15") to have any effect
  • DKMS set up so the module rebuilds automatically on kernel updates

Dependencies Omarchy installs for you

  • dkms

Pricing and license

Free and open source. License: GPL2.

Uninstall macbook12-spi-driver-dkms

omarchy pkg drop macbook12-spi-driver-dkms

Frequently asked questions

How do I install macbook12-spi-driver-dkms on Omarchy?

Open a terminal and run omarchy pkg add macbook12-spi-driver-dkms. The download is 54.8 KB and it takes 181.5 KB once installed. Omarchy pulls in any dependencies automatically.

Is macbook12-spi-driver-dkms free?

Free and open source. The package is licensed GPL2.

How do I uninstall macbook12-spi-driver-dkms?

Run omarchy pkg drop macbook12-spi-driver-dkms. It removes the package from your system.

What does macbook12-spi-driver-dkms depend on?

The package declares 1 dependency: dkms. Omarchy installs them for you.

Is macbook12-spi-driver-dkms a desktop app?

No. macbook12-spi-driver-dkms has no window of its own; it is a command-line tool, library or system component.

Is macbook12-spi-driver-dkms in the official Omarchy repo?

Yes. It is published as macbook12-spi-driver-dkms (version 0+git.315-2) in the official Omarchy package repository. marc-git makes it. Project site: https://github.com/marc-git/macbook12-spi-driver.
